keyFindings.description: arguments_carry's else arm matches the arguments' JSON text with the model's `i` intent in it for every direct (non-device) tool, so the intent-only false PASS item 4 closes for bash stays open for the bound read at stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh:3702: a `read` of .omp/skills/fixture-omp-skill/SKILL.md (which carries the same FIXTURE-SKILL marker) whose intent names skill://fixture-omp-skill satisfies `tool_result_answered read "skill://fixture-omp-skill" "FIXTURE-SKILL-OMP-<nonce>"`, though the skill:// resolution the assertion exists to prove never ran. Reproduced at a7c65674 with jq 1.7 over a two-line session: true; false once the intent is reworded. Fix: drop the intent from the match for every tool (parse the stored arguments, `del(.i)` on an object, match the rest; keep the bash `command` arm or let the one rule cover it), with a unit case for the read shape; device content carries no `i`, so the device match is unchanged.

The comment's "Every scan of the controller's deliveries below reads it" overstates: report_after_tick (:5347-5363) scans the sessions itself by raw text, since it needs each line's index. Wording; rides along with the fix, not gating.
